review.summary: Phoenix is currently in a research-only phase with significant gaps in its architecture and controls. It has not yet demonstrated the ability to meet the required empirical baseline for promotion, particularly due to the absence of settled 24-month outcomes and verified observations.
top_technical_reasons: Storage backends are not all connected.
Fact-check stage is injectable but not yet canonical.
Orchestrator not yet wired into Streamlit runtime.
review.candidate_safety: The current safety measures include immutable production flags and a hallucination audit, but the known gaps raise concerns about the overall safety of the implementation.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Connecting all storage backends will improve data integrity and availability.
next_experiments.change: Integrate remaining storage backends into the system.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Data integrity metrics and availability rates post-integration.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will help assess whether the integration of all storage backends resolves current data access issues.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Establishing a canonical fact-check stage will enhance the reliability of outputs.
next_experiments.change: Implement a canonical version of the fact-check stage.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Reduction in errors identified during audits.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will provide insights into the effectiveness of the fact-checking process and its impact on overall safety.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Wiring the orchestrator into the Streamlit runtime will improve operational efficiency.
next_experiments.change: Complete the integration of the orchestrator with Streamlit.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Operational efficiency metrics before and after integration.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will help evaluate the performance improvements gained from the integration.

review.data_or_label_risks: The lack of verified observations and the injectable nature of the fact-check stage pose risks to data quality and reliability.
